scope: Independent YJIT stats-correctness follow-up; not a runtime speed claim or part of the super fix
patch:
From f8946c7dc571b9cc38e9a8c512a2f39728541bda Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Thomas Klemm <github@tklemm.eu>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 19:40:41 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] YJIT: Count dynamic sends before dispatch

The VM call can raise or leave nonlocally, skipping the counter that
currently follows it. Count the dispatch before making the call so that
num_send_dynamic includes those sends, like the refusal counters do.

Test normal returns, exceptions, throw and block break independently.
---
 test/ruby/test_yjit.rb | 29 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 yjit/src/codegen.rs    |  5 +++--
 2 files changed, 32 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/test/ruby/test_yjit.rb b/test/ruby/test_yjit.rb
index 33e06d0022..c1a594d7e3 100644
--- a/test/ruby/test_yjit.rb
+++ b/test/ruby/test_yjit.rb
@@ -1900,6 +1900,35 @@ def entry = self.class
     RUBY
   end
 
+  def test_dynamic_send_counts_nonlocal_exits
+    {
+      'TARGET.call { 7 }' => 7,
+      'begin; TARGET.call { raise "test" }; rescue RuntimeError; 11; end' => 11,
+      'catch(:done) { TARGET.call { throw :done, 13 } }' => 13,
+      'TARGET.call { break 17 }' => 17,
+    }.each do |expression, expected|
+      assert_compiles(<<~RUBY, call_threshold: 30, exits: :any, result: [expected, 10, 10])
+        TARGET = Object.new
+        def TARGET.call
+          yield
+        end
+
+        def operation
+          #{expression}
+        end
+
+        100.times { operation }
+        RubyVM::YJIT.reset_stats!
+        result = nil
+        10.times { result = operation }
+        stats = RubyVM::YJIT.runtime_stats
+        return [result, 10, 10] unless stats[:all_stats]
+
+        [result, stats[:send_singleton_class], stats[:num_send_dynamic]]
+      RUBY
+    end
+  end
+
   def test_runtime_stats_types
     assert_compiles(<<~'RUBY', exits: :any, result: true)
       def test = :ok
diff --git a/yjit/src/codegen.rs b/yjit/src/codegen.rs
index 4a33b97571..08bd082100 100644
--- a/yjit/src/codegen.rs
+++ b/yjit/src/codegen.rs
@@ -9183,6 +9183,9 @@ fn gen_send_dynamic<F: Fn(&mut Assembler) -> Opnd>(
     // Save PC and SP to prepare for dynamic dispatch
     jit_prepare_non_leaf_call(jit, asm);
 
+    // Count dispatches even when the call raises or leaves nonlocally.
+    gen_counter_incr(jit, asm, Counter::num_send_dynamic);
+
     // Dispatch a method
     let ret = vm_sendish(asm);
 
@@ -9196,8 +9199,6 @@ fn gen_send_dynamic<F: Fn(&mut Assembler) -> Opnd>(
     // Fix the interpreter SP deviated by vm_sendish
     asm.mov(Opnd::mem(64, CFP, RUBY_OFFSET_CFP_SP), SP);
 
-    gen_counter_incr(jit, asm, Counter::num_send_dynamic);
-
     jit_perf_symbol_pop!(jit, asm, PerfMap::Codegen);
 
     // End the current block for invalidationg and sharing the same successor
-- 
2.39.5
reproduction_source:
MODE = ARGV.fetch(0)
N = Integer(ARGV.fetch(1, "1000"))
TARGET = Object.new
class ProbeError < StandardError; end
def TARGET.call
  yield
end

def operation
  case MODE
  when "return"
    TARGET.call { 7 }
  when "raise"
    begin
      TARGET.call { raise ProbeError }
    rescue ProbeError
      11
    end
  when "throw"
    catch(:done) { TARGET.call { throw :done, 13 } }
  when "break"
    TARGET.call { break 17 }
  else
    raise "unknown mode"
  end
end

def probe(n)
  total = 0
  i = 0
  while i < n
    total += operation
    i += 1
  end
  total
end

100.times { probe(100) }
before = RubyVM::YJIT.runtime_stats
total = probe(N)
after = RubyVM::YJIT.runtime_stats
expected = { "return" => 7, "raise" => 11, "throw" => 13, "break" => 17 }.fetch(MODE) * N
raise [total, expected].inspect unless total == expected
puts({ mode: MODE, calls: N, result: total,
       singleton_refusals: after[:send_singleton_class] - before[:send_singleton_class],
       num_send_dynamic: after[:num_send_dynamic] - before[:num_send_dynamic] }.inspect)
